description: diggercamp finds music that actually sounds alike. Paste a Bandcamp, YouTube or SoundCloud link and it returns tracks with a similar sound, analysed by rhythm, timbre, key and energy rather than tags or popularity. Dig deeper from a track you love, build a DJ set with key- and tempo-aware matching, find tracks that fit a whole playlist, or generate and save a full set that starts from one track and develops from there. Every result comes with a link to listen on its original source. You sign in with your diggercamp account, and your plan sets the limits.
